import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            String input = br.readLine();
            
            String[] parts = input.split("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
            int maxLen = 0;
            for (String part : parts) {
                maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, maxWordLength(part));
            }
            
            long underscoreCount = 0;
            int i = 0;
            while (i < input.length()) {
                if (input.charAt(i) == '(') {
                    int j = i + 1;
                    while (j < input.length() && input.charAt(j) != ')') j++;
                    if (j < input.length()) {
                        String content = input.substring(i + 1, j);
                        underscoreCount += countUnderscoreSegments(content);
                        i = j + 1;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                i++;
            }
            
            pw.println(maxLen + " " + underscoreCount);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    private int maxWordLength(String s) {
        if (s.isEmpty()) return 0;
        int max = 0;
        int start = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= s.length(); i++) {
            if (i == s.length() || s.charAt(i) == '_') {
                max = Math.max(max, i - start);
                start = i + 1;
            }
        }
        return max;
    }

    private long countUnderscoreSegments(String s) {
        if (s.isEmpty()) return 0;
        long count = 1;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '_') count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
}

    int computeMaxWord(String str) {

        StringTokenizer st;

                }

            return st.nextToken();

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
